task_description: Add AI Thumbnail Generator and Smart Playlist Manager features to the FastAPI+SQLite YouTube auto-uploader. Feature 1: analyze existing Gemini analysis JSON, render 1280x720 PNG thumbnails with Pillow in viral Indian YouTube style (vivid gradient, bold text, emoji), serve via REST. Feature 2: classify video genre from analysis JSON, check/create YouTube playlist via Data API v3, add video to matching playlist. Both features include UI buttons in library.html.
